pages.title: Sand Drop: Loop Puzzle
pages.creator: YIGOT
pages.description:
Sand Drop: Loop Puzzle turns pixel-art pictures into color-sorting challenges. Send buckets around a looping conveyor to collect sand of the matching color, working toward clearing the picture from the board. Conveyor space and bucket capacity are limited, so the order in which you send buckets matters as much as matching their colors.

You can merge matching buckets as part of your plan and use boosters as the puzzles progress. New artwork gives you different arrangements of colored sand to clear. Play with a mouse or touch controls; the game stores your progress locally in the browser.

pages.title: PixelTris
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description:
PixelTris turns falling-block play into a sand puzzle. Each piece breaks into grains when it lands, and a continuous band of one color clears when it reaches both side walls. Clear another band within three seconds to increase the combo multiplier. The run ends when the piled-up sand leaves no room for a new piece.

Move with Left/Right or A/D, rotate with Up, W, or X, and soft-drop with Down or S. Space drops the piece immediately. Touch controls use dragging to move, tapping to rotate, and a downward flick to drop.

pages.title: Aha World Dream Town
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Aha World Dream Town is a life simulation game with locations to visit and characters to create. Explore settings such as supermarkets, restaurants, shops, and a game center, moving between the different scenes. Use clicks or taps to interact with the town and build your own cast of characters.

pages.title: Jewel Link
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Jewel Link is a connect-two puzzle about clearing pairs of identical jewels. Find a matching pair and look for an available route that links them, then remove the pair from the board. Work through increasingly difficult arrangements, planning which connections will leave useful matches available afterward.

pages.title: Jump Dash
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Jump Dash is a rhythm platformer filled with spikes, traps, and other obstacles. Time the character's jumps as you work through the levels, using its jumping, gliding, and flipping movement to survive the route. Tap the screen or press Space to jump at the moment needed to clear the next hazard.

pages.title: Flower Block
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Flower Block asks you to arrange blocks into complete rows or columns. Clear lines to make room on the board, and finish several lines together to earn extra points and trigger combination effects. There is no rush, so consider how each placement affects the space left for the following blocks.

pages.title: Lights Out
pages.creator: dotekse
pages.description: Lights Out is a puzzle platformer where you must remember a route through darkness. Hold Space, or use the circular on-screen button, to illuminate the level and inspect the surroundings. You cannot move while the light is on, and keeping it active too long ends the attempt. Release it and use the arrow controls to travel from memory, avoiding traps and reaching the goal. Later worlds add keys, spikes, and moving platforms.

pages.title: Farm Match Seasons 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Farm Match Seasons 3 takes you back to Poppy's village farm for matching puzzles. Combine at least three identical items to remove them and work toward tasks involving strawberries, flowers, butterflies, and weeds. Larger combinations earn stronger rewards, including boosters and special gifts. Progress through the farm's increasingly demanding levels as you help with its harvest and upkeep.

pages.title: Domino World
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Domino World lets you place domino tiles by matching numbers and building a score. Choose Block or Draw mode for different ways to play, and collect trophies as you progress. Eight collectible domino sets provide other looks for the game, with further bonuses available along the Trophy Road.

pages.title: Submarine Attack
pages.creator: Gametok
pages.description: Submarine Attack puts you in command of a submarine fighting enemy ships with torpedoes. Aim at the targets, fire, and unlock additional weapons and abilities as the naval battles progress. With mouse or touch controls, hold and drag to aim, then use the red attack button. Keyboard controls use WASD or the arrow keys for aiming and Space to shoot; Shift speeds up the camera.

pages.title: Fish Land Fish World
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fish Land Fish World combines fishing with developing an aquatic world. Catch fish, expand the pond, and keep growing the setting through its idle-simulation activities. Click or tap to play as you build up the fishing area.

pages.title: City Banana Man Agent
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: City Banana Man Agent casts you as an armed banana agent exploring a city. Choose a landing spot, find the target, and complete the assigned task. Drive through the streets and use weapons to attack enemies along the way. Play with mouse clicks or taps during the agent's missions.

pages.title: Forest Tiles
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Forest Tiles is a block-placement puzzle on a nine-by-nine board containing coins. Fit the three available shapes into the grid to complete horizontal or vertical lines. Gold coins let you replace unwanted blocks or continue after losing. Plan placements around the occupied spaces while keeping room for the next shapes.

pages.title: Secret Rooms
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Secret Rooms is a timed hidden-object game. Search the room for the items named in the list on the left, clicking or tapping each one when you find it. Locate the full set before the countdown ends, and try to earn a high score and three stars for each room.

pages.title: CANDY LOVE
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: CANDY LOVE challenges you to clear groups of at least three matching candies. Tap a row to take a candy, then tap where you want to place it and build a matching group. Keep clearing the arrangement before the candies reach the bottom, which ends the game.

pages.title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Geometry Dash Maze Maps puts a glowing square on a route filled with obstacles. Time your jumps to get past each hazard and prepare for the next part of the course. Use Space on a keyboard or tap the screen to jump as you guide the square through the maze maps.

pages.title: Mr Bean Jump
pages.creator: Quizinc Ltd
pages.description: Mr Bean Jump has you time jumps onto moving blocks to climb as high as possible. Tap the screen when a block is ready for a landing and keep building a taller run. Unlock Mr Bean costumes, hats, backgrounds, and block designs drawn from the animated show.

pages.title: Sushi Supply Co
pages.creator: Digital Will Inc.
pages.description: Sushi Supply Co puts you in charge of a sushi business run by cat chefs. Tap the chefs to speed up sushi production and bring in more money. Improve the chefs and warehouse to increase income, building the business through its idle-tycoon progression.

pages.title: Unicorn Dress Up Coloring Book
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Unicorn Dress Up Coloring Book combines coloring with designing a pony unicorn's outfit. Select a color and apply it to a section of the animal, then choose details such as wings, hair, necklaces, capes, skirts, and dresses. Use the left mouse button to change the outfit and put together a colored character design.

pages.title: Nubic Stunt Car Crasher
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Nubic Stunt Car Crasher sends a stunt car down a ramp toward obstacles and structures made from cube blocks. Build enough speed to smash through the barriers and cause more destruction at the bottom. Spend upgrades on engine power, nitro, and bonus earnings. Accelerate with W or Up arrow and brake with S or Down arrow as you work through the sections.

pages.title: Super Ninja Plumber
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Super Ninja Plumber follows a plumber who becomes a ninja to save a mushroom world. Complete the levels and defeat the stone boss to finish the mission. Move with A/D or Left/Right, climb ladders with W/S or Up/Down, and crouch with S or Down. Z or K jumps, while X or L throws a shuriken. Touch buttons provide the controls on mobile.

pages.title: Bead Cleaner Amaze
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Bead Cleaner Amaze is a clearing puzzle played by moving a cleaning tool. Slide to guide it through the colored beads, removing every bead in the arrangement to finish the level. Each stage presents another layout to clear, so work out how the tool needs to travel through it.

pages.title: Lead the Ant
pages.creator: Simplicity Games
pages.description: Lead the Ant asks you to draw a route that brings an ant to its food. Click and hold to lay down the line it should follow, planning a path from the ant to the treat. Complete the route so the ant can reach its meal.

pages.title: Find Differences Halloween
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find Differences Halloween presents two similar Halloween pictures. Inspect them for details that do not match and select each difference you find. Hints can help when a detail is difficult to spot. Finishing with time and unused hints remaining adds to the bonus score. Use the mouse or touchpad to play.

pages.title: Halloween Mahjong Tiles
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Halloween Mahjong Tiles is a timed tile-matching puzzle with Halloween symbols. Remove pairs of identical tiles, choosing pieces that have an open left or right side. Clear the whole arrangement before the clock runs down. Hint and shuffle buttons can help when the next available pair is difficult to find.

pages.title: Drifting Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Drifting Mania challenges you to stay on a winding road by controlling a rope. Tap, hold, and release at the right moments to guide the car through the turns. Earn money from drifting and spend it on unlocking and customizing cars. Keep the run going while working toward the game's achievements.

pages.title: Fruit Pop Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Fruit Pop Multi player is a fruit-matching challenge you can play against friends. Draw a line through fruit to collect it, aiming for larger clears to improve the score and earn bonus features. Some stages require special blocks to be cleared, and each level limits your moves. Quick completions provide additional bonus items.

pages.title: Bubble 2048
pages.creator: DDSH
pages.description: Bubble 2048 combines bubble shooting with number merging. Move left or right to aim, then release to fire a numbered bubble into the arrangement. Combine numbers toward 2048; reaching that value triggers an explosion that clears more bubbles. Work out where each shot will help build the next larger number.

pages.title: Squid Assassin
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Squid Assassin asks you to plan attacks on workers and a dangerous doll while staying out of their gunfire. Select a destination with the mouse or touch controls and choose an approach that lets the character attack quietly. Progress through the levels and visit the shop for characters with different abilities.

pages.title: Minimal Dungeon RPG
pages.creator: CapPlay
pages.description: Minimal Dungeon RPG represents dungeon rooms, tasks, enemies, and rewards as simple squares. Click the squares to explore connected rooms, take on challenges, and collect their rewards. Work deeper through the dungeon while following the story, making progress through a compact presentation of a role-playing adventure.

pages.title: Idle Money Tree
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Money Tree has you collect money bags growing on a tree. Tap the bags to earn coins, tapping quickly to raise the multiplier. Reinvest earnings in sunlight, watering cans, fertilizer, fruit, and genetic research. Keep improving the tree as you develop its income-producing upgrades.

pages.title: Ninja Rian Adventure
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Ninja Rian Adventure sends a ninja after Dracula, who has kidnapped a princess. Fight enemies and bosses while crossing the adventure's obstacles, using jumps, gliding, sword attacks, and thrown darts. Move with A/D or the arrow keys, jump with Space or Up, attack with J, throw a dart with K, and dodge with L.

pages.title: Freddy Run 3
pages.creator: rungames.org
pages.description: Freddy Run 3 takes place inside Freddy's nightmare of a haunted medieval castle. Guide him through corridors, rooms, and dungeons while fighting monsters and escaping traps. Survive the route to face the Skeleton King in the final one-on-one battle. Use the arrow keys to move and jump, and press X to shoot.

pages.title: Happy Connect
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Happy Connect is a line-connection puzzle played by rearranging tiles. Drag the movable line blocks into an arrangement where all the lines connect. Some tiles are fixed, so build the rest of the route around their positions. Complete the connection to move on to the next level.

pages.title: Princess Dirty Home Changeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Dirty Home Changeover helps Princess Clara clean up after her busy school schedule. She has a holiday available to tackle her messy home, and you take part in the cleaning activities. Use the mouse to work through the tasks and give the house its changeover.

pages.title: Flappy Dunk
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Flappy Dunk challenges you to keep a basketball moving through hoops. Click to make the ball jump and time its movement toward the next ring. Keep landing successful shots as you try to travel farther through the course.

pages.title: Lucky Toss 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Lucky Toss 3D recreates a ring-tossing challenge in three dimensions. Slide to throw a ring and judge the toss so it lands accurately on the target. Work on the direction and strength of each throw as you take on the tossing challenges.

pages.title: Amazing Sudoku
pages.creator: Amazing Games Network
pages.description: Amazing Sudoku is a number puzzle played on a nine-by-nine grid. Fill the cells with digits from one to nine while avoiding repeated numbers in each row, column, and block. Use draft notes to track possible answers, undo a move when you reconsider it, or request a hint when you need help finishing the grid.

pages.title: Among.io
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Among.io puts you in charge of a crowd that grows by collecting food. Gather more to increase its size, then absorb rival crowds smaller than your own to add their members. Power-ups can boost your speed or double the crowd. Click and drag the mouse to guide the group around the arena.

pages.title: Frenzy Farming
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Frenzy Farming has you run a farm through a series of production missions. Plant grass, feed chickens, and collect their eggs, using coins at the well when you need more water. Later levels add cows and milk, alongside products such as bread and cakes. Check the mission panel for the current goals, and use the car icon to sell goods at the market when you need money. Play with mouse clicks and swipes.

pages.title: Jump Color
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Jump Color asks you to keep a ball bouncing between the left and right walls without letting it fall. Click the left mouse button or tap the screen to control the bounce. Collect stars during the run for additional points and try to improve your high score.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Bubble Shooter is a level-based puzzle about clearing colored bubbles. Aim shots to form groups of three or more matching bubbles and burst the arrangement. Clear the bubbles to open the next level. On a computer, Space switches the bubble available for your next shot, giving you another option while planning a match.

pages.title: Crazy Shark
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Crazy Shark follows Johnny, a shark who enters a war zone while swimming to visit relatives. Help him survive and find a way through the dangerous waters. Use the arrow keys to change his position and press X to shoot as you guide him onward.

pages.title: Panda Holic
pages.creator: SUCCESS Corporation
pages.description: Panda Holic is a rhythm-and-reaction game about tapping moving targets at the correct moment. Watch their movement and time each tap to keep playing. Missing the required timing ends the attempt, so concentrate on the next target as the sequence continues.

pages.title: Motorbikes Spot the Differences
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Motorbikes Spot the Differences presents two similar motorcycle photos in each level. Compare their details and find all five differences between them. Use the mouse or tap the screen to select a detail that does not match and complete the picture comparison.

pages.title: Football Storm Strike
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Football Storm Strike challenges you to score football goals with curved shots. Drag the mouse along a curve to direct the attempt toward the goal. Judge the shape of the drag as you work on placing more successful strikes.

pages.title: Perfect Pipes
pages.creator: Gamearcade.org
pages.description: Perfect Pipes is a physics puzzle about connecting a route for a group of balls. Drag the flexible pipes into place and link them in the correct order so every ball can enter the pipe system. Work out which connections provide the path needed to complete each arrangement.

pages.title: Eye Glasses Designer
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Eye Glasses Designer lets you create eyewear for Mia, Bella, Ada, and Claire. Choose the shape, design, and decorations for their glasses, then select outfits to go with the finished pairs. Use mouse clicks to work through the design and dress-up choices.

pages.title: Jet Ski Summer Fun Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Jet Ski Summer Fun Hidden is a timed hidden-star search set in jet-ski pictures. Inspect each scene and click or tap the concealed stars to mark them as found. Locate the complete set before the countdown expires, then continue to the next picture.

pages.title: Word Search Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Word Search Challenge has you find animal names hidden in a letter board. Compare the animals with the scrambled grid and select their names when you locate them. The letters associated with a found animal change color to show your progress. Play five levels featuring animals from land and underwater settings, using mouse or touch input.

pages.title: Helix Ascend
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Helix Ascend is an arcade challenge built around a spiral tower of glass rings. Break through the rings to work toward the tower's edges, using the mouse to play. Keep advancing through the tower as you destroy the glass sections.

pages.title: Monster Truck VS Zombie
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Monster Truck VS Zombie puts a monster truck on driving courses with enemies and a finish flag to reach. Use the arrow keys to control the vehicle and work through the levels. Vehicle upgrades improve attributes such as maximum speed, acceleration, and torque, helping you develop the truck for further runs.

pages.title: Quick Color Dice
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Quick Color Dice is a timing game built around a die and a rotating color wheel. Send the die toward a section of the same color to make a correct match and increase your score. Play with the mouse or touch input, choosing from Quick Game, Speed Game, and Time Attack options.

pages.title: Butterfly Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Butterfly Slide offers three butterfly images to reconstruct as sliding puzzles. Select a picture and one of three modes, then use the mouse to move its tiles into position. Rearrange the fragments until the complete butterfly picture is restored.

pages.title: National Class
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: National Class challenges you to keep a car racing for as long as possible. Drive quickly while avoiding other cars and obstacles that interrupt the route. Use the arrow keys and mouse controls to play as you try to extend the race.

pages.title: Winter Sports Jigsaw
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Winter Sports Jigsaw offers ten winter-sports pictures to assemble. Drag pieces into place with mouse or touch input, choosing one of three difficulty modes for the selected image. Completed puzzles earn in-game money used to unlock further pictures, and the hardest mode gives a larger reward.

pages.title: BTS Santa Claus Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Santa Claus Coloring lets you add colors to pictures of Santa Claus. Choose a shade from the available palette and use the mouse or touch input to apply it to the drawing. Try different colors as you create your own version of the Christmas picture.

pages.title: Fire Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Fire Trucks Memory asks you to find matching pairs of fire-truck cards. Click or tap to uncover pictures and remember their positions as you look for the next pair. Complete each level's matches and finish quickly to earn a time bonus.

pages.title: Cake Maker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Cake Maker challenges you to decorate a cake to match a sample. Choose icing colors and apply frosting to your cake, comparing its appearance with the target design. A match rating shows how closely the result follows the example. Use the mouse to work through the decorating activity and try other cake designs.

pages.title: Tri Jeweled
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Tri Jeweled is a gem-swapping match-three puzzle with levels and power-ups. Use a mouse or touchpad to swap jewels into combinations of at least three matches. Make useful clears and use the available power-ups as you work through the level challenges.

pages.title: Pop Corn Fever
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Pop Corn Fever challenges you to fill a popcorn tub without spilling the contents. Hold the left mouse button to keep producing popcorn, then stop when the container has enough. Each level changes the tub's shape, so judge the available space again before filling it.

pages.title: Stealth Prison Escape
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Stealth Prison Escape challenges you to get out of a guarded prison without being caught. Find routes past security cameras, lasers, noise detectors, machine guns, and crushing presses. Locked doors require keys, and police guards can be sleeping, awake, stationary, or moving. Use the mouse to play while planning how to avoid the security obstacles.

pages.title: Rolling City
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Rolling City puts you in control of a ball rolling through a city and crushing objects. Hold and move to steer it through the surroundings. Start with small buildings to help the ball grow, then keep rolling through the city and increasing its destructive size.

pages.title: Didi & Friends Coloring Book
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Didi & Friends Coloring Book lets you color characters such as Didi, Nana, Jojo, Tatak, Bingo, and Pak Atan. Pick colors and adjust the brush size as you work on the illustrations. Finished pictures can be saved and printed, giving you a paper version of the coloring activity.

pages.title: Penguins Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Penguins Jigsaw offers twelve penguin pictures to assemble. Choose an image and select Easy, Medium, or Hard before fitting the pieces into the completed picture. Use the mouse to arrange the fragments and work through the penguin collection at the difficulty you prefer.

pages.title: Stickman vs Zombies
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Stickman vs Zombies is an endless shooting game with a shop for improving your character's equipment. Fight the zombies, buy upgrades, and use the wheel feature during your progress. Move with A/D or Left/Right, jump with W or Up, fire with Space or Q, and press E to change weapons.

pages.title: Crown and Ambition
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Crown and Ambition is an interactive story following Captain Kirana Asha and her companion Evans. Investigate dark forces plotting against King Adler and decide how to act as the story develops. Your choices affect the kingdom's fate, so consider each action while trying to uncover the conspiracy and its perpetrators.

pages.title: dead sticks
pages.creator: Supernapie
pages.description: dead sticks is a physics puzzle about clearing a screen of hanging and falling sticks. Click or touch the circles to release their supports and let the sticks move. Work out which circles to remove to free the remaining pieces and clear the arrangement.

pages.title: Crazy Race
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Crazy Race is a driving game with a drifting theme. Take on the challenge of handling vehicles ranging from SUVs to exotic cars as you work toward a place among elite drivers.

pages.title: Bear Boom
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Bear Boom is a jelly-matching puzzle with targets to finish within a limited number of moves. Select a group of at least three adjacent jellies of one kind to collect them. Groups of seven or more create special explosive jellies. Plan those larger clears to help complete the level's objectives before your moves are used up.

pages.title: Rise Up Color
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Rise Up Color asks you to protect a balloon by moving a shield ahead of it. Push obstacles out of the way and keep a clear route as the balloon rises. Position the shield where the next obstruction is approaching so the balloon can continue its climb.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Beauty Backyards
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzle Beauty Backyards offers sixteen photographs of outdoor spaces to reconstruct. Fit the jigsaw pieces together to rebuild each backyard view. Work through the collection of garden and yard pictures, using the details in each scene to match its fragments.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Valentine Dinner
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Valentine Dinner takes a couple to a restaurant for a Valentine's Day date. Set their table with flowers and candles, then help the evening continue with strawberries and kisses. Tap to play through the dinner activities and reach the surprise at the end of the date.

pages.title: Plane Tunnel
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Plane Tunnel is an endless flying challenge about guiding an aircraft through a tunnel. Steer past the obstructions along the route and try to keep the flight going for a higher score. The game includes two plane models and records your best score for another run to challenge.

pages.title: Rogue Tail
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Rogue Tail is a turn-based dungeon adventure with randomized areas to explore. Plan moves through the dungeon, fight its monsters, and gather treasure, items, and spells while leveling the hero. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use 1 through 4 for skills. Touch controls are available for the mobile version.

pages.title: Design Your Baby Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design Your Baby Room lets you help expectant parents prepare a room for their baby. Choose from the offered furniture and decorations to put together the nursery. Try different pieces from the designer's suggestions and coordinate the room's appearance.

pages.title: Duck Carnival Shoot
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Duck Carnival Shoot is a timed shooting-gallery game. Aim at the ducks and hit them before the countdown finishes, earning coins to improve accuracy. Mini-missions provide more coins and special targets, including a Mafia Duck boss, police ducks, and ducks dressed in business suits.

pages.title: Toy Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Toy Shop lets you design dolls for three young customers. Customize each doll's skin, eyes, and hairstyle, then choose clothing and accessories to complete it. Try different combinations to create an individual doll for each girl.

pages.title: Wheely 8
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Wheely 8 follows Wheely and Jolie after an alien spacecraft interrupts their picnic. The lost visitors need a map back to their planet, and Wheely sets out to find it. Click objects in each scene to interact with the surroundings and help Wheely move through the adventure.

pages.title: Saturday Night Linker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Saturday Night Linker is a disco-themed connection puzzle played on a dance floor. Draw routes between pairs of squares with matching colors and work out how the required links fit together. Progress through one hundred puzzles, with boards ranging from six-by-six to nine-by-nine squares.

pages.title: Mahjong Dynasty
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mahjong Dynasty takes you through an Asian-themed series of tile puzzles. Click matching mahjong tiles to remove pairs and work toward clearing the board. Complete the levels while aiming for a three-star result in each one.

pages.title: Spy Car
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Spy Car mixes driving missions with vehicle combat. Take the equipped car along the tracks and destroy enemy vehicles using guns and rockets. Complete the assigned missions while handling the car and its weapons. Use the keyboard for movement.

pages.title: Royal Wedding Ceremony
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Royal Wedding Ceremony lets you help a royal bride prepare for her wedding. Choose a wedding dress and coordinate it with accessories for the ceremony. Work through the bridal styling choices to put together her finished wedding look.

pages.title: Festie Words
pages.creator: ArtBit
pages.description: Festie Words is a holiday-themed word-search puzzle. Inspect the letter grid and drag across letters to select a word you have found. Correct selections are marked as completed, helping you track the words still missing. Find the required words to finish each puzzle and continue through the themed challenges.

pages.title: Pac Xon
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pac Xon combines area capture with ghosts on the playfield. Cut off sections of the area to capture the ghosts and make progress through the levels. Plan where to divide the field so each new section helps you take control of more space.

pages.title: Fairy Cannon
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fairy Cannon is a timed bubble-popping game with a fairy theme. Clear the bubbles before the countdown expires, using mouse or keyboard controls to play. Work toward popping the whole arrangement within the available time.

pages.title: Pancake Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Pancake Bar puts you in charge of preparing pancakes for waiting customers. Check their orders and use the recipe book to choose the right combination of ingredients. Press Create to make the dish, which travels along the conveyor to a customer with the matching order. More recipes become available as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Spider Solitaire challenges you to organize cards into descending runs from King to Ace. Click and drag the cards into position as you sort the layout. Choose one suit for a simpler game, or try the two-suit and four-suit modes for a more demanding arrangement.

pages.title: Girls Ball Dress up
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Girls Ball Dress up helps Ellie, Annie, and Belle prepare for a New Year ball at a castle. The friends meet before the celebration to choose their looks. Pick makeup, dresses, and accessories for each girl and coordinate the outfits for the occasion.

pages.title: Sweet Sisters Dress-up!
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Sweet Sisters Dress-up! lets you create new fashion looks for two princesses. Choose outfits for both sisters from the available wardrobe and try different combinations. Give each character a finished style while working through their dress-up options.

pages.title: Sery Runway Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Sery Runway Dolly Dress Up H5 has you style Sery for a luxury-brand fashion show. Choose from four items at a time and build an outfit for the runway model. Coordinate your selections to give Sery a distinctive look for introducing the new fashion line.
